item.title: Assam Govt To Forwards Case On Gaurav Gogoi's Alleged Pakistan Links To Home Ministry
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Assam government has decided to forward the case relating to Congress MP Gaurav Gogoi’s alleged links with Pakistan to the Union Ministry of Home Affairs for further investigation. The decision was taken at a Cabinet meeting held on Saturday, February 7, after a detailed discussion on the findings of a Special Investigation Team probing alleged anti-national activities involving Pakistani national Ali Tauqeer Sheikh, MP Gaurav Gogoi and his wife, Elizabeth Gogoi.
